ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial aspects of the ongoing investigations in Minnesota, including the daycare scandal and the Good and Pretti killings.
questions: What financial transactions are related to the investigations?
Are there any suspicious patterns or connections?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may uncover new leads or connections in the investigations. This could help to shed light on the larger issues at play and potentially uncover wrongdoing.
